name: Hagrid’s Motorbike Adventure
description: A story-filled motorbike coaster through the Forbidden Forest.
queueNote: Outdoor stretches and themed ruins; save the long wait for a return time.
motion: Fast launches, sudden drop and a backward section.

name: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey
description: Step inside Hogwarts, then fly alongside Harry.
queueNote: A must-see queue: portraits, Dumbledore’s office and the classroom. Greenhouse / outdoor portions can be hot. Ask the attendant which sights your entrance includes.
motion: Strong simulated flying, tilting and screens. Motion-sensitive riders may prefer to sit this one out.
sourceName: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey™

name: Jurassic World VelociCoaster
description: The day’s biggest adrenaline hit: launches, inversions and a waterfront top hat.
queueNote: Indoor raptor exhibits, but the queue can extend outdoors.
motion: Intense launches, inversions and large drops. Secure loose items; follow locker instructions.

name: The Incredible Hulk Coaster
description: A powerful launch straight into a giant twisting coaster.
queueNote: Laboratory theming with covered and indoor portions.
motion: Intense inversions and positive G forces; lockers / metal detection.

name: The Amazing Adventures of Spider-Man
description: A spectacular comic-book adventure with physical sets and 3D action.
queueNote: The Daily Bugle queue is mostly indoors; overflow can be outside.
motion: Spinning vehicles, 3D screens and simulated drops.

name: Flight of the Hippogriff
description: A short, gentler coaster with a lovely castle view.
queueNote: An outdoor path past Hagrid’s hut.
motion: A short coaster with turns and small drops.

name: Hogwarts Express → Diagon Alley
description: Travel to Universal Studios and London. Both directions tell a different story.
queueNote: Hogsmeade station; some waiting is outside. Park-to-Park ticket required.
motion: Gentle train with screen scenes. Check the destination park is open.

name: Jurassic Park River Adventure
description: A dinosaur boat journey with a big splashdown finale.
queueNote: Mostly outdoor / covered queue. Better while there’s time to dry.
motion: Big final drop. You may get quite wet; splash varies by seat.

name: Dudley Do-Right’s Ripsaw Falls
description: A playful log flume with a steep final drop.
queueNote: Some covered sections; save for a warm afternoon.
motion: Likely soaked, including shoes. Large drops.

name: Popeye & Bluto’s Bilge-Rat Barges
description: A chaotic family raft ride through rapids.
queueNote: Mostly outdoors. This is a commit-to-getting-wet ride.
motion: Expect to get soaked. Protect your phone and plan drying time.

name: The Cat in the Hat
description: A colorful indoor ride through the storybook.
queueNote: Mostly indoors; an easy change of pace.
motion: Vehicle turns and spins.

name: Storm Force Accelatron
description: The kids can dial up the spin on these superhero teacups.
queueNote: Covered attraction; queue is not an air-conditioned reset.
motion: Strong spinning, especially if you turn the wheel.

name: Doctor Doom’s Fearfall
description: A fast blast skyward with a great park view.
queueNote: Comic-book villain lab and outdoor loading.
motion: Sudden vertical launch and drops.

name: Ollivanders wand experience
description: Watch a wand choose a wizard. A memorable first-visit stop.
queueNote: Small indoor show; the line outside can be hot. An interactive wand purchase is optional.
motion: Standing show with lighting and sound effects.

name: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts
description: The essential Diagon Alley ride: a bank heist beneath Gringotts.
queueNote: A must-see queue through the goblin banking hall. Indoor theming is part of the experience; overflow may be outside.
motion: 3D screens, spinning, a coaster drop and sudden motion.
sourceName: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts™

name: Hogwarts Express → Hogsmeade
description: Head back to Islands for your evening finale.
queueNote: Look for the Platform 9¾ illusion. Park-to-Park ticket required.
motion: Gentle train with screen scenes; this direction has its own story.

name: Revenge of the Mummy
description: A fantastic indoor coaster with darkness, fire effects and surprises.
queueNote: Atmospheric indoor tomb queue; overflow can be outside.
motion: Fast coaster turns, a backward section, sudden stops and fire effects.

name: MEN IN BLACK Alien Attack
description: A family score contest: aim at aliens and compare scores afterward.
queueNote: An indoor MIB headquarters queue.
motion: Vehicles spin sharply during the ride.

name: E.T. Adventure
description: A classic flying-bike adventure, perfect for the whole family.
queueNote: The indoor forest queue is a highlight all by itself.
motion: Gentle suspended motion and dark scenes.

name: TRANSFORMERS: The Ride-3D
description: A loud, high-energy 3D battle with giant robots.
queueNote: Mostly indoor military-base theming.
motion: Strong simulator motion, 3D screens and sudden turns.

name: The Simpsons Ride
description: A chaotic animated adventure through Krustyland.
queueNote: Covered queue and indoor preshow.
motion: Intense screen-based simulator motion; a useful one for a motion-sensitive rider to assess carefully.

name: Despicable Me Minion Mayhem
description: Join Gru’s Minion training with familiar characters.
queueNote: Indoor preshow; much of the waiting can be outside / covered.
motion: Screen-based simulator motion. Ask about stationary seating.

name: Villain-Con Minion Blast
description: A moving-walkway blaster game with a score to chase.
queueNote: Mostly indoor convention-style queue.
motion: Standing on a moving walkway; flashing effects and screens.

name: Trolls Trollercoaster
description: A short, colorful family coaster.
queueNote: Outdoor queue.
motion: A small coaster with quick turns.

name: The Bourne Stuntacular
description: A spectacular live stunt show and a seated, air-conditioned change of pace.
queueNote: Check the next actual showtime; allow time to arrive and enter.
motion: Loud effects, gunfire and large screens; no ride vehicle.

name: Horror Make-Up Show
description: A funny live look at movie makeup and special effects.
queueNote: Check actual showtimes. Indoor theater.
motion: Mock gore, loud surprises and audience comedy.

name: Ollivanders wand experience
description: Watch a wand choose a wizard. A memorable first-visit stop.
queueNote: Small indoor show; the line outside can be hot. An interactive wand purchase is optional.
motion: Standing show with lighting and sound effects.

name: Explore Hogsmeade
description: Butterbeer, Honeydukes and a first look at Hogwarts. Give yourselves time to notice the details.
queueNote: Self-paced exploring. Shops offer indoor moments; crowds and food lines vary. Wand activities need a compatible interactive wand.
motion: Walking only. Pause or leave whenever you like.

name: Three Broomsticks
description: A Wizarding World meal together. Check the Universal app for menus, availability and ordering.
queueNote: Indoor dining; ordering lines and table availability vary. Meal wait is not tracked here.
motion: A seated meal, with time to cool down.

name: Explore Diagon Alley
description: Explore the shops, watch for the dragon, and find the atmospheric Knockturn Alley. Try Butterbeer along the way.
queueNote: Self-paced exploring. Shops offer indoor moments; crowds and food lines vary. Wand activities need a compatible interactive wand.
motion: Walking only. Pause or leave whenever you like.

name: Leaky Cauldron
description: A Wizarding World meal together. Check the Universal app for menus, availability and ordering.
queueNote: Indoor dining; ordering lines and table availability vary. Meal wait is not tracked here.
motion: A seated meal, with time to cool down.
